# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 10 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in 1QH Column 10 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 10:1 — "yiggal nifla'ot" — "do great wonders" vs. "accomplish great wonders"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "do great wonders" | Simple literal |
| LOGOS | "accomplish great wonders" | Formal, weightier |
| PNEUMA | "do that counts as a great wonder" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "accomplish great wonders." More weighty for the rhetorical question.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:2 — "ad" — "until old age" vs. "until the day they die"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "until old age" | Literal seivah |
| LOGOS | "until old age" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "until the day they die" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained "until old age" (EMET/LOGOS). The Hebrew says seivah, not "death."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 10:5 — "tom" — "perfect" vs. "blameless"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "to make perfect the way" | Traditional |
| LOGOS | "to make the way blameless" | Precise |
| PNEUMA | "shapes their way into something whole" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "to make perfect the way." In the refrain, "perfect" must be consistent with "perfection of way" in 10:3.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 10:6 — "benei retsono" — "good-pleasure" vs. "favor"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the sons of His good-pleasure" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "the children of His favor" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "all whom God has chosen" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "the children of His favor." Natural and accurate.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:10 — "ne'alavim" — "vile" vs. "wretched" vs. "corrupt"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the vile" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "the wretched" | Moral and existential degradation |
| PNEUMA | "the corrupt" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "the wretched." Captures both moral and pitiful dimensions.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:14 — "qamti" — "arose and stood" vs. "rose and stood firm"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "arose and stood" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "rose and stood firm" | Emphatic |
| PNEUMA | "stood back up" | Colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "rose and stood firm." Emphatic form warrants "firm."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:18 — "yatsarta" — "created" vs. "fashioned"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "created" | Standard |
| LOGOS | "fashioned" | Artisanal connotation |
| PNEUMA | "made" | Simplified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "created." Theological weight needed for predestination statement.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 10:20 — "yechashev" — "accounted righteous" vs. "reckoned as righteous"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "accounted righteous" | Traditional |
| LOGOS | "reckoned as righteous" | Pauline resonance |
| PNEUMA | "counted as righteous" | Simplified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "reckoned as righteous." Forensic/accounting language (cf. Romans 4).

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:33 — "kun" — "established" vs. "ordained"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "established" | Standard |
| LOGOS | "ordained" | Theological, predestination |
| PNEUMA | "ordained" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "ordained" (LOGOS/PNEUMA). In divine speech-predestination context, "ordained" is precise.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA.

---

## 10:37 — "'olamim" — "forever" vs. "for all eternity"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "forever" | Simple |
| LOGOS | "for all eternity" | Doxological |
| PNEUMA | "without end" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "for all eternity." Appropriate grandeur for closing doxology.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements in Column 10: 10**
